caption: The drawing depicts a circular ceramic plate with a decorative design. The plate features a central motif consisting of a stylized plant with large leaves and three prominent flowers. Two of the flowers are positioned symmetrically on either side of the central stem, and they are rendered in brown with dotted accents. The plant has multiple green leaves and extends upwards and outwards from the center. Below the plant, an eagle with outstretched wings is situated in the lower section of the plate; the eagle’s wings are marked with dotted brown patterns, its body is decorated with vertical stripes, and it faces forward. The eagle is flanked by two small leafy branches. Around the edge of the plate runs a band with handwritten text in a script style, and the date "May 18 ten 1826" is inscribed in the lower left and right quadrants. The interior of the plate shows light green and brown washes, and the outer rim is brown. The drawing is centered on a plain beige or off-white background, and the artist's signature and date "E.H. Sholl ’37" appears on the lower right of the surrounding background.
title: Pa. German Plate
